notes: Maps each source's own trim naming onto our car ids. Sources: carwow (pasted quote pages, key = make|model|derivative), carwow-cap (public deals pages, key = CAP derivative id), hyundai-cap (Hyundai UK offer pages, key = CAP code), ncd / leaseloco (key = make|model|derivative, normalised), rrg (key = kia|derivative). A row without car_id is status 'ignored': a derivative we deliberately don't track (wrong pack, no heat pump, non-EV). A scraped key missing here lands in silver but not gold and shows as 'unmapped' in the snapshot and `pipeline trims`.
